hero.description: Specialized in designing and developing end-to-end tech solutions, integrating modern <1>Web</1> and <3>Mobile</3> applications with scalable, high-performance <5>APIs</5>.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a Full Stack Developer focused on building efficient, scalable systems. My journey in Information Systems is driven by delivering clean code, solid architectural patterns, and user-centric interfaces.
about.p2: As a Full Stack developer, I work across the development lifecycle, from building interfaces to implementing APIs and databases.
about.p3: I continuously strive for excellence in software development best practices, continuous integration, and modern design patterns.

highlights.frontend: Building responsive, reactive, accessible user interfaces with React and TypeScript.
highlights.backend: Engineering robust RESTful APIs and high-performance microservices using Node.js and Go (Golang).
highlights.database: Designing and managing advanced relational databases with PostgreSQL and MySQL.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A curated selection of applications built with a focus on code quality, architecture, and usability.

tcc.short: Mobile platform for tracking glucose readings, habits, and achievements.
tcc.full: An evolution of the original Flask-based capstone project, now organized as a monorepo with a React Native and Expo app, a Go and Chi API, PostgreSQL, and local SQLite persistence.

tcc_api.short: Go (Golang) RESTful backend API supporting the capstone app.
tcc_api.full: Robust backend service crafted with Go (Golang) and MySQL for centralized data management, user authentication, and business domain logic.

vendas.short: Commercial management and sales operations platform.
vendas.full: Application designed to streamline commercial workflows, offering sales tracking, records management, and decision-making metrics.

dile.short: Full Stack platform integrating frontend and backend services.
dile.full: Integrated end-to-end architecture across all application layers, demonstrating seamless data flow, input validation, and high service interoperability.

juros.short: Financial analysis and calculation simulation tool.
juros.full: Tool focused on financial accuracy, enabling interest calculations, yield projections, and dynamic reports via an intuitive interface.

portfolio.short: Multilingual professional portfolio focused on projects and technical experience.
portfolio.full: Application built with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, featuring internationalization, themes, project filters, a gallery, and a contact form.

aether.short: Modern ERP system for corporate enterprise management.
aether.full: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform built to centralize workflows, financial management, inventory control, and strategic reporting with high performance.

goshortner.short: Full stack platform for shortening, managing, and analyzing links.
goshortner.full: Application with a Go and Echo backend, PostgreSQL persistence, and a React interface. It includes authentication, analytics, QR codes, and bio link pages.

netpulse.short: Real-time network metrics and health monitoring system.
netpulse.full: Network observability solution built with Node.js and React to monitor infrastructure availability, latency metrics, and real-time network diagnostics.
